# Radiance — Power Ponies (G4)

Radiance is the jewel-powered unicorn superhero of the fictional city of Maretropolis. Her civilian identity is *Green Gardener* in licensed trading-card lore; in *Friendship is Magic*, **Rarity temporarily becomes Radiance** when Spike's enchanted comic pulls the Mane Six into its story. That does not make Rarity and the original comic-book heroine the same person. Spike actually calls her “Radiance” in [“Power Ponies” (S4E6, 21 December 2013)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wNG7jmYu-NY), so the name is from the show, not a fan invention.

Radiance's trademark is a dark-blue mask and superhero suit with bright pink gemstones and power bracelets that conjure solid objects—anything from a tea set to an umbrella. Rarity keeps her white coat and curled purple mane in the TV version; the original Radiance has different coloring and styling in IDW's comic. [Writer Ted Anderson's production notes](https://tedlyanderson.tumblr.com/post/98304209564/annotations-for-my-little-pony-annual-2014) explicitly distinguish the original Power Ponies from the Mane Six and describe Radiance as exceptionally vain. The [Enterplay Radiance card, PP3](https://data.mlpmerch.com/tc/type/power-ponies/), supplies Green Gardener's origin: a zeppelin pilot rescues an alien hero and receives his magical bracelets, as reproduced in the [character and card-lore reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Power_Ponies_(characters)). *Green Gardener* is licensed card lore, not a name revealed in the episode.

Rarity-as-Radiance speaks, voiced in English by *Tabitha St. Germain* ([episode credits](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt3098722/fullcredits/)); the separate original comic heroine has no verified TV voice credit. Besides S4E6, Radiance appears as an independent character in IDW's *My Little Pony Annual 2014*. Human Rarity also wears a Radiance costume for a film-set mix-up in *Equestria Girls: Movie Magic* ([special transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/My_Little_Pony_Equestria_Girls%3A_Movie_Magic)); this is costume play, not a new superhero identity.

## Important moments

- *Named in Maretropolis* — “Power Ponies” (S4E6): Spike recognizes Rarity as Radiance after the friends enter the enchanted comic. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Power_Ponies). *Verified scene; video timestamp unavailable.*
- *An accessory that saves the day* — “Power Ponies” (S4E6): Rarity learns her bracelets can create objects, progressing from an impractical tea set to a useful umbrella during the henchpony battle. *Video timestamp unavailable.*
- *Learning to be a team* — *My Little Pony Annual 2014* (comic; no S/E): Radiance's vanity is part of the original team's infighting until Humdrum helps the heroes learn cooperation.
- *Restoring their powers* — *My Little Pony Annual 2014*, p. 34 (comic; no S/E): Radiance, Mistress Mare-velous and Humdrum modify the villains' power-stealing machine, helping turn the fight around.
